note: Restraint corpus v2. Three classes instead of two: the v1 audit found that the nothing-durable label mixed 'nothing durable about the work' with 'nothing the user decided, but tool output present', and an independent judge kept about half of the second kind. tool_output chunks declare the tool fact that is defensible to keep (probes) and the chatter that is not (transient).
